title: alchemilla altaica f. cryptocaula
intro: Alchemilla altaica f. cryptocaula, commonly known as the Siberian lady's mantle, is a plant species in the Rosaceae family. The plant is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have led to its use in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Alchemilla altaica f. cryptocaula include reducing inflammation, soothing wounds, and supporting the digestive system. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and act as an antiseptic agent, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
